However, my goal is to get into x or w. Given the general preference for y, x will be highly competitive. Since I have the highest priority at x, my best chance is to stick with x as my first choice. If I am rejected from x, w is my next best option. I should not waste a proposal on y, as it is likely to be oversubscribed and my priority is not high.

Therefore, my ranking will remain as x > w > y > z. This strategy maximizes my chances of getting into my top choices, x or w, while still having z as a fallback. It's a gamble on my high priority at x being enough to overcome the general preference for y.
